Segnala offerta di lavoro Kindly submit your resume in English for consideration. CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER. It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers. Job Description The Opportunity: The Marketing Manager – EMEA will lead the planning and execution of Mattel Masterbrand's highest-profile marketing activations across Europe, the Middle East and Africa, bringing the brand to life through breakthrough consumer experiences, integrated campaigns, media partnerships, retail programs and live events. This role will also lead marketing strategy and activation for select Mattel Creations collaborations with EMEA-based partners, serving as the regional marketing lead from partnership development through launch execution. Working closely with Global, local market teams and external partners, this role will translate global strategies into culturally relevant regional activations while delivering best-in-class execution that strengthens brand equity, consumer engagement and business impact across EMEA. Operating at the intersection of strategy and execution, this role requires a collaborative marketer who can manage multiple initiatives simultaneously, influence cross-functional stakeholders, steward agency partners and deliver exceptional consumer experiences throughout the region What Your Impact Will Be: Lead planning and execution of Mattel Masterbrand campaigns and evergreen initiatives across EMEA , including integrated marketing, media, experiential, and retail extensions. Own EMEA-based Mattel Creations collaborations from identifying and cultivating partnerships to contract negotiations to developing and executing integrated go-to-market plans; partnering with GBT on global strategy, brand creative and hand off for product development. Lead strategy, planning and execution of Mattel's presence at EMEA-based Comic Cons, including Lucca. Manage regional activation budgets, ensuring investments are strategically allocated, optimized and tracked. Gather and synthesize consumer, retail and cultural insights from across EMEA to inform regional decision-making and future global planning. Serve as the connective tissue between Global Masterbrand and EMEA, partnering across Brand Marketing, Category Activation Marketing, Local Marketing, Media, PR, Influencer and Commercial teams to ensure strong plans and execution. Manage agency partners and external vendors to deliver best-in-class consumer experiences and partnership activations. Establish KPIs and measurement frameworks to evaluate campaign performance, optimize investments, and capture learnings for future activations. Qualifications What We’re Looking For: 7+ years experience in brand, integrated, regional or local marketing. Experience executing integrated marketing campaigns and consumer activations across multiple markets. Strong project and program management skills with the ability to manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously. Experience managing agency partners, production timelines, and marketing budgets. Strong business and financial acumen with experience managing activation investments and ROI. Excellent cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills. Ability to influence and build strong working relationships across Global, Regional and Local teams. Excellent communication, presentation, and organizational skills. Highly collaborative, proactive, and comfortable operating in fast-paced, highly matrixed environments. Proficiency in Outlook, PowerPoint, Word and Excel. Additional Information What We Offer: Gross annual salary range of EUR 66,400 - EUR 78,850 Bonus scheme: Participation in Mattel Incentive Plan (MIP) with the target of 15% of base salary, payout is determined by company and individual performance results Time off according to CCNL Giocattolo Industria Hybrid working set-up Meal allowance Employee assistance program: Access to Modern Health, Headspace, and Maven Health insurance AD&D Insurance Flexible benefit (kindergarten, public transport or vouchers) Toy discount Christmas gift Family benefits program: 24 weeks off (for 1st caregiver) or 12 weeks off (for co-parent) fully paid on the arrival of new child, return to work program, path to parenthood, and family care leave Mattel’s total compensation package is based on objective, gender-neutral criteria such as job grade, work location, relevant skills, and experience. This information is provided to enable informed and transparent consideration and negotiation of employment terms. If your profile is retained and we schedule an interview, we will share further details on Mattel Italy S.R.L.’s total rewards package. Please note that (some of) the benefits above may change over time, due to changes in the company policy or in legislation. We will not ask about your previous salary history. Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to Join Mattel's Talent Community and start receiving exciting updates about our company, our employees, and our culture. Also, interested in signing up for job alerts? Do so here! You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. How We Work: We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors: We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower. We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking. We execute: We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results. Our Approach to Flexible Work: We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter. Who We Are: Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more. Visit us at https://jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers. Beware of recruiting scams: Mattel will only contact you through official @mattel.com or @smartrecruiters.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. Mattel is an Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers, and all applicants will receive consideration for employment. Segnala offerta di lavoro Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Visable Giulia Gilardi Giulia Gilardi HR Manager Italy & Spain Informazioni sull’azienda: Visable, filiale europea di Alibaba e leader nei marketplace B2B in Europa, aiuta le PMI a trovare nuovi clienti e sviluppare il proprio business sui mercati internazionali attraverso Europages e WLW, le nostre piattaforme B2B disponibili in 26 lingue. Da oltre 30 anni supportiamo le aziende nella loro crescita commerciale e oggi siamo in una fase di forte espansione in Europa. Per rafforzare il nostro team commerciale in Italia, cerchiamo un/a Customer Acquisition Manager che ci aiuti a sviluppare nuove opportunità di business, acquisire nuovi clienti e far crescere Visable sul mercato italiano. Le tue principali responsabilità saranno: Gestire l’intero ciclo di vendita, dalla ricerca di nuovi prospect alla presa di contatto, dalla demo alla negoziazione e alla chiusura. Individuare e acquisire nuovi clienti B2B, comprendendo le loro esigenze e proponendo le soluzioni più adatte, tra cui Europages, WLW, Google Ads, Google Shopping e retargeting. Parlare con imprenditori e decision maker, costruendo relazioni commerciali solide e accompagnandoli nel percorso di acquisto. Gestire il tuo portafoglio clienti, assicurando un’esperienza positiva e mantenendo una relazione costante nel tempo. Monitorare la tua attività e i tuoi risultati attraverso i nostri strumenti interni, condividendo feedback e idee per migliorare i risultati del team. Formazione e supporto: Fin dal tuo ingresso in Visable, riceverai una formazione completa sui nostri prodotti, sulle soluzioni e sui metodi di vendita. Avrai a disposizione ogni giorno una base lead, oltre a strumenti digitali che ti aiuteranno nella gestione della tua attività, tra cui Sugar CRM, software di follow-up automatico e simulatori per la gestione dei prospect. Profilo: Hai almeno 2 anni di esperienza nella vendita di soluzioni digitali (l’esperienza nel telemarketing, nella vendita telefonica o in ambito B2B sarà considerata un plus). Hai una forte attitudine commerciale, sei determinato/a e orientato/a al risultato. Ti motivano gli obiettivi e non ti scoraggi davanti a un “no”. Hai ottime capacità comunicative e relazionali e sai creare rapidamente un rapporto di fiducia con i clienti, anche al primo contatto. Sei una persona autonoma, organizzata e proattiva, che sa gestire le proprie attività e lavorare per obiettivi. Hai una buona dimestichezza con i principali strumenti digitali e informatici. Cosa offriamo: Contratto a tempo determinato o indeterminato, commisurato alla tua esperienza nel ruolo. Modalità di lavoro ibrida: 50% in ufficio e 50% smart working, combinando la flessibilità del lavoro da remoto con i vantaggi della collaborazione in team presso il nostro ufficio di Milano (MM3 Lodi Tibb). Pacchetto retributivo: €29K di fisso + €33K di variabile target (OTE €62K), con una componente variabile senza tetto, pagata mensilmente in base ai risultati raggiunti. Buoni pasto da €10 al giorno. Tutti gli strumenti e device necessari per svolgere al meglio il tuo lavoro. Diversity & Inclusion: In Visable crediamo nella diversità, nell’inclusione e nelle pari opportunità. Abbiamo firmato la Diversity Charter e promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro in cui ogni persona possa sentirsi rispettata e valorizzata. Con oltre 50 nazionalità e più di 20 lingue parlate, siamo orgogliosi di essere un’azienda realmente internazionale.
